verification.context: In Tarzan (1999), what is the full name of Jane's scientist father?

premise.reason: The licensing handbook film-background section gives Archimedes Q. Porter.

sources.locator: Disney Theatrical licensing handbook, Background / Tarzan Swings onto Broadway, printed page 36: discussion specifically of film development names Professor Archimedes Q. Porter and daughter Jane. Used for film background, not stage plot.
Synopsis and cast identify Professor Porter as Jane father in 1999 film. Corroborates relationship independently of full-name handbook.
